senses.gloss: m.(b. h. חֹק; חקק , v. preced.) [circle, drawing, engraving,] law, rule, custom; assigned share, mark.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 54a:5">Erub. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>אניח לבני ח׳</he> I will leave to my sons a due share (a fixed living).
<cite ref="Shabbat 137b:7">Sabb. 137ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ בשארו שם</he> He ordered a mark to be put on his (Abraham’s) flesh.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 111a:2">Snh. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>שמשייר אפי׳ ח׳ אחד</he> (some ed. <cite ref="H01547"><he>חֹק</he></cite>) who leaves even one law unobserved.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 111a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>למי שלא עשה אפי׳ ח׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. differ., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) who observed not even one law; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חוּקִּים</he>, <he>חֻקִּים</he>.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 39a:8">Kidd. 39ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 19:19">Lev. XIX, 19</cite>) <he>ח׳ שחקקתי נכ׳</he> the lines which I have drawn long ago (by creating separate species); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 1:7:3">Y. Kil. I, 27ᵇ</cite> top (it is forbidden) <he>משום ח׳ … בעולמי</he> as coming under the interpretation of (Lev. l. c.) “the lines which I have drawn &c.” <cite ref="Tamid 31b:24">Tam. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>חוּקֵּי העמים</he> customs of gentiles. Sifra Aḥăré ch. XII, Par. 9 <he>ח׳ החקוקים וכ׳</he> (idolatrous) usages practiced by them and their fathers &c, v. <cite ref="H00442">next w.</cite>; a. fr.
